payout_quote: FanDuel Sportsbook is giving New Customers the chance to get $250 in Bonus Bets by betting $5 each day for five consecutive days. ... Bonus will be issued as nonwithdrawable Bonus Bets that expire 7 days after receipt.
timing: $50 in bonus bets issued per qualifying day over 5 consecutive days; bonus bets expire 7 days after receipt; only winnings (stake excluded) are withdrawable
eligibility: New customers only; 18+ in DC/KY/PR/WY, 21+ in AZ, AR, CO, CT, IL, IN, IA, KS, LA (select parishes), MD, MA, MI, MO, NJ, NY, NC, OH, PA, TN, VT, VA, WV; physically present in those jurisdictions; promotion runs 12:00 AM ET Sep 21, 2026 to 11:59 PM ET Oct 12, 2026
steps: Sign up for FanDuel Sportsbook, verify account, deposit at least $5
Place one real-money wager of $5+ between 3AM and 11:59PM ET each day for 5 consecutive days
Receive $50 in bonus bets per qualifying day (up to $250 total)
Use bonus bets within 7 days; withdraw only the winnings
catches: this is a bet, not income: you must risk $25 of your own real money across 5 consecutive days; every qualifying wager can lose, and losing all 5 days plus losing with the bonus bets leaves you with $0 from the promo.

The $250 is nonwithdrawable Bonus Bets, not cash - the stake is never returned, so only the profit portion of a winning bonus bet becomes withdrawable (e.g. a $50 bonus bet at -110 that wins returns ~$45.45 in profit, not $95.45).
Bonus bets expire 7 days after receipt; unused tokens are forfeited.
If you miss a day, you lose that day's $50 - the 5 days must be consecutive.
biggest_catch: this is a bet, not income: you must risk $25 of your own money over 5 consecutive days, the $250 arrives as non-withdrawable bonus bets that expire in 7 days, and only winnings (stake excluded) can ever be withdrawn.
notes: Official FanDuel page (fanduel.com/research/...) loaded and quoted verbatim 2026-09-23. Limited-time NFL promo: Sep 21 - Oct 12, 2026. Realistic withdrawable value is far below $250: bonus-bet winnings at typical -110 odds return ~45.5% of face as profit (stake excluded), so the max realistic cash value of all $250 in bonus bets is ~$114, and only if every bonus bet wins.
